question: The mean and the mode of a set of data are 20 and 88.7, respectively. Find the median of the data, using the empirical formula.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the rearranged empirical formula directly: Median = (Mode + 2 × Mean) ÷ 3

Median = (88.7 + 2 × 20) ÷ 3

Median = (88.7 + 40) ÷ 3 = 128.7 ÷ 3

Median = 42.9

**∴ The correct answer is 42.9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean = 20

Mode = 88.7

**Formula Used:**

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean
